Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interprets the magazine's publication start date (1913) as the organization's founding year, fabricating a false premise that directs all subsequent searches.       description: The Planner fails to instruct the WebSurfer to click on the specific result link (e.g., the 2016 news post) that contains the explicit founding year quote, relying instead on search snippets which may be ambiguous.
      severity: 0.6

    - type: irrecoverability_issue
